business_summary.text: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited is a prepared foods company serving retail and foodservice customers across global markets, with a focus on authentic, convenient and innovative food solutions.

call_points.text: Management expects continued momentum in Third-Party Business and recovery in Affiliates Business to drive future growth.
No specific capex guidance provided, but continued investments in Cheffin and HoReCa businesses are expected.
Cheffin business has benefited from learnings on Amazon and expansion into quick commerce through Zepto.
Margins are under pressure due to inflationary costs from geopolitical developments, but cost optimization measures are being implemented.
Company maintains a debt-free status and strong cash position to support future growth.
External geopolitical developments and inflationary pressures pose risks to margins and profit growth.

operating_notes.text: Postal ballot institutional votes showed 98.61% to 99.01% dissent against material related-party transactions with Preferred Brands International and Mars Food UK.
Company became fully debt-free in FY26 following repayment of all borrowings.
Cheffin business has expanded into quick commerce through Zepto in March 2026.
HoReCa business is supported by expansion of Food Service portfolio and growth of Formed Frozen Products range.
Shareholders approved material related-party transactions with Mars Food UK Limited via postal ballot.

timeline.summary: Tasty Bite Eatables announced postal ballot results where shareholders rejected material related-party transactions with Preferred Brands International and Mars Food UK but approved director remuneration.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹117.69 Cr (-12.0% YoY), net profit ₹6.01 Cr (-2.9% YoY).
Tasty Bite Eatables reported FY26 revenue at ₹571.62 Cr with PAT up 38% to ₹35.30 Cr, turning debt-free and proposing a 100% dividend.

Tasty Bite Eatables Limited reported Q1FY27 results with revenue growing 29% YoY to ₹161.6 Cr and PAT growing 8% YoY to ₹8.8 Cr, driven by strong recovery in Affiliates business (+46% YoY) and continued momentum in Third-Party business (+15% YoY).
Tasty Bite Eatables announced postal ballot results on October 28, 2026, where shareholders approved material related-party transactions with Mars Food UK Limited.
